system.description: As a Standard Action, you allow one Droid that can hear and understand you to make a Deception, Mechanics, Persuasion, Pilot, Ride, Treat Injury, or Use Computer check immediately as a Free Action. The Droid can replace its relevant Ability Score modifier for that check with your Intelligence modifier.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
